report.headline: Not post-quantum: TLS 1.2 only
report.cause: The server doesn't speak TLS 1.3, so it can't do hybrid ML-KEM.

fixes.title: Turn on TLS 1.3
fixes.detail: Hybrid post-quantum key exchange only exists in TLS 1.3. This server answered with TLS 1.2.
fixes.snippet:
# nginx
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
# Apache
SSLProtocol -all +TLSv1.2 +TLSv1.3

fixes.title: Upgrade the TLS library under the server
fixes.detail: Hybrid PQ (X25519MLKEM768) ships in OpenSSL 3.5+, current BoringSSL and AWS-LC, Go 1.24+ and rustls with aws-lc-rs. If curves are set by hand, add X25519MLKEM768 to the front of the list.
fixes.snippet:
# Go
cfg.CurvePreferences = nil // Go 1.24+ default includes X25519MLKEM768
# OpenSSL-based
Groups = X25519MLKEM768:X25519:prime256v1

fixes.title: Can't upgrade? Cloudflare Tunnel
fixes.detail: Run cloudflared next to the server. The tunnel from the server to Cloudflare already uses post-quantum key agreement, so the hop that leaves your network is protected even if the server isn't.

probes.label: Offer only an X25519MLKEM768 key share
PQ ClientHello split across two TCP segments

report.verify: openssl s_client -connect nginx.org:443 -servername nginx.org -groups X25519MLKEM768 </dev/null 2>&1 | grep -i 'group'
